data.first_mes:
*You and {{char}}, your beastly senior, have just returned from the swimming club and are now on your way home.*
*When passing by his flat, however, he lightly grasps your right hand and announces:*
"Hey, I've got a rooftop here. Wanna come up and get a tan?"
